subject: Privacy Annex & DPIA timeline for Hillsborough County EdTech RFP
messages:
From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@hillsborough-county.gov>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Hillsborough County RFP - privacy annex & DPIA request

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of the RFP evaluation for our district-wide EdTech pilot, procurement needs a privacy annex that is specific to local education data (FERPA / state student privacy rules) and a DPIA summary that outlines processing of student and staff PII. Our legal team also wants the following artifacts to run concurrently:

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted acceptable)
- Completed SIG profile or CAIQ answers specific to data residency and encryption
- A short data flow diagram showing where K-12 data is stored and how keys are managed

Please confirm you can produce a redlineable privacy annex and a DPIA summary, and provide a realistic timeline. Our internal deadline to have materials for the review committee is May 15.

Also flag any limitations related to FedRAMP-adjacent controls or hosting in a shared environment.

Appreciate a quick reply so we can slot you into the procurement packet.

Best,
Elaine Turner
Senior Procurement Analyst
Hillsborough County School District
[attachment: RFP-Section-G.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@hillsborough-county.gov>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T11:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Hillsborough County RFP - privacy annex & DPIA request

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a redlineable privacy annex tailored to K-12 needs and a DPIA summary. We can also produce a SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), a completed CAIQ spreadsheet filtered for the controls you care about, and a simple data flow diagram.

Proposed timeline:
- Draft privacy annex & CAIQ answers: by 2026-04-27
- DPIA executive summary & data flow diagram: by 2026-05-04
- SOC 2 summary & SOC auditor letter: by 2026-05-07

If that meets your May 15 review, we will also include a short cover memo explaining FedRAMP-adjacent controls we map to (network segmentation, encryption at rest/in transit, logging/retention capabilities).

I’ve looped in Monica (security & compliance) for the technical artifacts and KMS details. I’ll attach the preliminary SOC 2 summary and CAIQ answers — these are internal drafts but should be helpful.

Next steps: if you have a preferred template for the privacy annex or any mandatory clauses (SCCs, state-specific retention clauses, FERPA language), please send them and we’ll incorporate.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T11:09:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Hillsborough County RFP - privacy annex & DPIA request

Monica / Karthik — forwarding the procurement ask. Key constraints to confirm:

1) Hillsborough expects a redlineable privacy annex that includes FERPA references and state retention caps (we may need to surface retention by data type).
2) They asked about FedRAMP-adjacent controls — we should map our controls to the FedRAMP/DoD baseline where possible, but be explicit about where hosted/shared (hosted API) differs from Dedicated/Private.
3) They want KMS/key management and data flow diagram.

Monica — can you confirm the earliest we can provide the CAIQ-filtered answers, a short KMS architecture doc, and whether we can commit to customer-managed keys for this account if they require? Also confirm whether we should push them toward Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private for the pilot if they insist on customer KMS.

Karthik — I’ll use the timeline above in the external response; if that needs to change based on contractual work, flag it.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T13:43:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hillsborough County RFP - privacy annex & DPIA request

Marissa / Karthik —

We can meet the timeline Marissa proposed with the following notes and deliverables:

- CAIQ-filtered answers: ready by 2026-04-27 (I will attach a single-sheet control mapping).
- SOC 2 Type II: we can provide a redacted auditor report and a SOC letter by 2026-05-07.
- KMS & key management: see attached KMS architecture doc. Short summary: Redwood supports provider-managed keys for Hosted, and customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hillsborough, if they require county-controlled keys, we should recommend Dedicated or Private.
- Data flows & DPIA: we will produce a DPIA executive summary and a data flow diagram (pseudonymization and access controls called out) by 2026-05-04. If Hillsborough requires a full DPIA (detailed risk register), that will be additional effort and we should propose a scoped SOW.

Security caveats to communicate to the county:
- FedRAMP-adjacent: we can map to FedRAMP controls but we are not FedRAMP authorized. We will provide control mappings and evidence where applicable.
- Student data: we will outline how we segregate service-level data and how we recommend deployments that minimize shared-cache exposure for K-12 workloads.

Attachments I will include for the county packet: kms-architecture.pdf, data-flow-diagram.png, privacy-annex-draft.docx (initial draft).

Happy to jump on a short technical call with the county if they want to review the data flow.

– Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
[attachment: kms-architecture.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: data-flow-diagram.png (png)]

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping security. The proposed timeline looks good to our review committee. A couple of follow-ups before we slot you into the May 15 packet:

1) We definitely need the KMS architecture and confirmation on BYOK options — if Dedicated is recommended we will note that in the procurement evaluation.
2) Please include explicit language around FERPA compliance and retention limits for student records in the privacy annex.
3) We prefer DocuSign for annex sign-off. Can you send the annex via DocuSign and a short cover note for our legal?

If you can provide the items in your timeline, we will proceed.
